leave_sick_accrual_002.answer: Yes, accumulates. Cap is 200 days (document states 'two hundred (20) days') for employees hired prior to Jan 1, 2009, and 175 days for those hired after Jan 1, 2009.
leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: Sick leave allowance to which an employee becomes entitled but does not use during each school year shall be accumulated to a maximum of two hundred (20) days. ... accumulated to a maximum of one hundred seventy-five (175) days.
